Christine of Mecklenburg-Güstrow Christine of Mecklenburg- Güstrow( 14 August 1663 – 3 August 1749) was a German noblewoman of the House of Mecklenburg and by marriage Countess of Stolberg- Gedern. Born in Güstrow, she was the sixth of eleven children born from the marriage of Gustav Adolph, Duke of Mecklenburg- Güstrow and Magdalene Sibylle of Holstein- Gottorp. From her ten older and younger siblings, eight survived to adulthood: Marie( by marriage Duchess of Mecklenburg- Strelitz), Magdalene, Sophie( by marriage Duchess of Württemberg- Oels), Charles, Hereditary Prince of Mecklenburg- Güstrow, Hedwig( by marriage Duchess of Saxe- Merseburg- Zörbig), Louise( by marriage Queen of Denmark and Norway), Elisabeth( by marriage Duchess of Saxe- Merseburg- Spremberg) and Augusta. She was the three- times great- grandmother of Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom.
